description: This file defines a React functional component named 'PromptMessagesCard' that renders a UI for managing a list of prompt messages, supporting drag-and-drop reordering, addition, and removal of messages. It uses various imported UI components such as Card, Text, Select, and custom VariableTextArea.

methods.name: handleDragStart
methods.description: Sets the index of the message being dragged.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior and updates the index over which the dragged element is hovering.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping the dragged message onto a new position, triggering reordering via onMoveMessage callback.
